Players Committee card image of [[Sith Fury (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, exchange a Dark Jedi in hand with a Dark Jedi in Lost Pile.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/sithfury.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
